text:
maria: Heads-up — ran into a case where proxied service tokens are being accepted for project-scoped endpoints even when the token has no project claim. Repro below, happened on staging.
maria: Repro (short):
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TOKEN\" \
  -H \"X-Forwarded-By: svc-proxy\" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/v1/projects/1234/embeddings
```
expected: 403 if token.project missing. actual: 200, request routed as svc-proxy and acted on project 1234. logs attached in staging.
aj: Can you paste the token claims (redacted) — want to verify sub/aud/project/origin fields.
maria: quick claims (redacted): `{\"sub\":\"svc-a\",\"aud\":\"redwood:api\",\"project\":null,\"proxy\":\"svc-proxy\",\"iat\":1758880000}`
vikram: yikes. our current checks accept if aud==redwood:api and proxy in allowlist -> then we skip project validation for performance. that's the bug. we assumed proxies always include project context, but they don't.
samir: we have a tradeoff: either (A) tighten checks (deny when project absent unless delegation proof is present), or (B) require proxies to mint a short-lived delegated token that includes project claim (token-exchange path). A is fast to roll out, B is cleaner but needs infra changes and latency.
aj: Proposal for a pragmatic rollout:
- short-term (canary): deny requests where token.project==null AND request path contains /projects/:id unless header `X-Delegation-Proof` present and verified. Log + metric `auth.proxy_missing_project_denied`.
- medium-term: implement token-exchange endpoint for proxies to mint per-project child tokens (OAuth-like) and deprecate allowlist bypass.
maria: I can open an RFC PR. For the canary we need acceptance criteria: 1) metric emits, 2) <0.1% of production requests hit the new deny after 48h, 3) rollback path defined.
vikram: Suggested verification logic (pseudo):
```
if (token.project == null && path.matches('/projects/:id')) {
  if (!token.delegation_proof || !verify_delegation(token.delegation_proof, path.project)) {
    audit.log('deny_missing_project', {sub: token.sub, proxy: token.proxy, path});
    return 403;
  }
}
```
delegation_proof = signed blob by project-admin keys, expires quickly.
aj: Also add an invariant test in the auth middleware unit tests + an e2e that exercises an outdated proxy that doesn't exchange tokens.
deploy-bot: infra-note: alert rule `auth.proxy_missing_project_rate` created in staging but not prod. (reaction :white_check_mark:)
sre-lead: For rollout, prefer canary in staging -> small prod % (10%) -> monitor metric and user impact for 24-72h. If false positives spike, rollback.
samir: Owners & next steps:
- RFC PR: @maria (by EOW)
- middleware changes + unit tests: @aj (PR next week)
- e2e + canary config: @vikram + @sre-lead
- plan token-exchange RFC (scope) as follow-up: @samir
maria: I'll start the RFC and include repro logs + test vectors. anyone object to the short-term deny approach? (needs fast mitigation)
aj: 👍 no objections. let's ensure we include a migration note for proxies in Dedicated/Private customers.
vikram: Add a compatibility header we can use to detect old proxies: `X-Proxy-Version`. If absent and token.project==null -> stronger logging + automatic quota throttling to minimize blast.
maria: Thanks — creating the PR now. Will tag everyone for review and add the staging alerts + dashboards.
samir: +1. thanks all.
